profile.name: 自动微孔板培养箱
profile.description: 一种用于存放并温控培养微孔板或培养板的自动化实验室培养箱，通常具有多个板位、装载托盘和可开闭门机构，可在设定温度下进行样品孵育，并支持板件取放与振荡混匀。常用于细胞培养、酶反应、样品保温和自动化流程中的板式孵育步骤。
profile.description_en: An automated laboratory incubator for storing and temperature-controlling microplates or assay plates. It typically provides multiple plate sites, a loading tray, and a door mechanism, allowing incubation at a set temperature as well as automated plate transfer and shaking. It is commonly used for cell culture, enzyme reactions, sample holding, and plate incubation steps in lab automation workflows.
